name: TabStops
description: A collection of all the TabStop objects on one ruler.
example:
With ActivePresentation.Slides(1).Shapes(2) _
        .TextFrame.Ruler.TabStops
    For t = .Count To 1 Step -1
        .Item(t).Clear
    Next
End With

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: DefaultSpacing
properties.description: Returns or sets the default tab-stop spacing for the specified text, in points. Read/write.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single tab stop from the specified TabStops collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the single TabStop object in the collection to be returned.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Type As PpTabStopType, Position As Single) As TabStop
methods.description: Creates a tab stop and adds it to the TabStops collection.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of the tab stop to be added.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: The position of the tab stop in the tab stops collection.
